scope: One bounded parent-local repair and rehearsal. Reuse known existing pnpm store, reject unknown store before installer, add two focused tests, format recovery files, reconcile completed interrupted local stage, run all recovery tests and five ordered stages. Stop at first error. No engine source modification or deletion, no extra worker or external publication.
script:
import sys,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd()
p=repo/'tools/recovery/setup.py'
s=p.read_text()
old='''    cache = repo / ".aperture-env"
    env = os.environ.copy()'''
new='''    cache = repo / ".aperture-env"
    modules = repo / "node_modules/.modules.yaml"
    if modules.exists():
        stores = [line[len("storeDir: "):].strip() for line in modules.read_text().splitlines()
                  if line.startswith("storeDir: ")]
        if len(stores) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("existing dependency store is unknown; preserve modules and reconcile")
        candidates = [repo / ".recovery-env", repo / ".aperture-env"]
        matching = [candidate for candidate in candidates
                    if stores[0] == str(candidate / "data/pnpm/store/v10")]
        if len(matching) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("existing dependency store differs; preserve modules and reconcile")
        cache = matching[0]
    env = os.environ.copy()'''
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
p=repo/'tools/recovery/test_setup.py'
s=p.read_text()
test='''    def test_existing_recovery_store_is_reused(self):
        modules = self.root / "node_modules/.modules.yaml"
        modules.parent.mkdir()
        store = self.root / ".recovery-env/data/pnpm/store/v10"
        modules.write_text("storeDir: " + str(store) + "\\n")
        self.assertEqual(setup.environment(self.root)["XDG_DATA_HOME"],
                         str(self.root / ".recovery-env/data"))

    def test_unknown_existing_store_is_preserved(self):
        modules = self.root / "node_modules/.modules.yaml"
        modules.parent.mkdir()
        modules.write_text("storeDir: /unrecognized/store/v10\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            setup.environment(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(modules.read_text(), "storeDir: /unrecognized/store/v10\\n")

'''
assert '    def test_save_is_complete_json(self):' in s
p.write_text(s.replace('    def test_save_is_complete_json(self):',test+'    def test_save_is_complete_json(self):'))
p=repo/'tools/recovery/README.md'
p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('may be a different version; do not assume its version matches the repository',
'may be a different version; do not assume its version matches the repository. Existing dependency stores in the two known local recovery layouts are reused; an unknown store is preserved and blocks installation before any replacement prompt'))
manifest=Path('/workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-tmp/run-4bd57e81818b43dbab1bb4440e72feec/.manifest.json')
m=json.loads(manifest.read_text())
assert m['state']=='completed' and m['exitcode']==130
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'tools/recovery'))
import setup
statepath=repo/'.aperture-env/recovery-state.json'
state=json.loads(statepath.read_text())
assert state['stages']['dependencies']['status']=='running'
state['stages']['dependencies'].update(status='failed', reconciliation='Exact prompt process cancelled with SIGINT; execution session 51950 ended exit 2; subreaper lifecycle completed exit 130 after descendants exited. Original modules store retained.')
setup.save(statepath,state)
subprocess.run(['node','node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs','--write','tools/recovery/README.md','tools/recovery/render.mjs','tools/recovery/runtime/package.json','tools/recovery/runtime/pnpm-lock.yaml'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3','-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tools/recovery','-p','test_*.py','-q'],check=True)
for _ in range(5):
    subprocess.run(['python3','-B','tools/recovery/setup.py','advance'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3','-B','tools/recovery/setup.py','status'],check=True)
